source: P2 fixed 10 Hz windows and type arrays
split: per-log chronological 70/15/15 inherited unchanged from P2
stage2_inclusion: binary anomaly label equals 1 and anomaly type is one of 1..4
window_type_rule: majority non-zero anomaly type within the window plus horizon segment

excluded.Normal: not used to fit the conditional four-class Stage 2 model
excluded.Uncategorized: reserved for the optional Unknown Fault experiment

leakage_control: no new split is created; P2 train, validation and test membership is preserved
